correctness.rationale: PASS: The map f↦T_f(a,b)=(f(a,b),f(b,a)) is an anti-isomorphism to maps commuting with coordinate swap. Bijective maps split into independent permutations of n diagonal points and signed permutations of N=binom(n,2) two-cycles, giving S_n×B_N. For n≥3 its abelianization is C2^3. For B_N, generators (e1,c_N),(0,(12)) produce allones via u^N and an independent e2 via (uv)^(N−1), then all coordinate flips by conjugation; three product-group generators recover adjacent S_n transpositions and full B_N. At least two distinct nonunit types (nonbijective/bijective diagonal restriction) must occur in any full monoid generating set because I and nonunits are ideals and each type exists. Direct signed-permutation closure independently found |B3|=48 and |B4|=384, consistent; all-n proof is algebraic.
